alerts.title: Rainfall causing road closures
alerts.description: Rainfall has led to debris on paved roads, and dangerous muddy conditions on dirt roads. Several roads have been closed, additional road closures are expected as additional roads are assessed for damage. Travel on any dirt roads is strongly discouraged. Road closures are promptly updated on our Current Conditions page (linked at "more" below).

alerts.title: Gas Pumps at Panamint Springs Resort are Closed at Night
alerts.description: Gasoline is available at Panamint Springs Resort from 7am-9:30pm, daily. Gas is available at Furnace Creek and Stovepipe Wells 24hrs.

alerts.title: Some Roads Closed due to Flood Damage
alerts.description: A storm on 10/22 caused flooding in several areas of the park, which washed debris across roads.
